turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
You asked for this meeting; I'd have been here either way. Pleasantries aren't an answer, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Don't manage me, Hale. I'm not here about my record, I'm here about Owen's. Yes or no.
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.

In your position I'd have called the parent before entering a mark, because your own procedure, 4.2, says so. You said "following the evidence." Then show me the evidence, Hale, because so far all I've heard about is a piece of software.
